title: Loop Engineering: Version-Bound, Evidence-Gated Coordination for Production Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.18571v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents can edit repositories and execute tests, yet production software work extends far beyond code generation. It requires durable task context, scoped authority, version-aware approval, source-independent verification, interruption recovery, and accountable handoffs between humans and automated workers. We present Loop Engineering, a method for operating multiple asynchronous agent loops over shared, auditable repository state without relying on private conversational handoffs. Each loop is specified by six elements: a trigger, a context projection, an authority boundary, a verifier, a stop condition, and a write-back rule. Versioned procedural contracts, called Skills, encode reusable operating policy; a Harness bounds the available action surface and collects evidence; human gates authorize high-consequence transitions against exact artifact versions. translated_title: 循环工程：面向生产级编码代理的版本绑定、证据门控协调
translated_abstract: 编码代理能够编辑代码仓库并执行测试，但生产级软件工作远不止代码生成。它需要持久的任务上下文、范围受限的权限、版本感知的审批、与来源无关的验证、中断后的恢复，以及人类与自动化工作者之间可问责的交接。我们提出 Loop Engineering（循环工程），这是一种在共享、可审计的仓库状态上运行多个异步代理循环的方法，无需依赖私有的对话式交接。每个循环由六个要素定义：触发器、上下文投影、权限边界、验证器、停止条件和回写规则。被称为 Skills（技能）的版本化程序性契约编码了可复用的操作策略；Harness（执行框架）限制可用的操作面并收集证据；人工门控则针对确切的制品版本对高后果的状态转换进行授权。我们报告了一项来自 MewDesign（一家产生收入的……）的设计与经验研究（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“循环工程”方法，通过触发器、上下文投影、权限边界、验证器、停止条件和回写规则六要素规范异步代理循环，并借助版本化技能契约、证据收集框架与版本绑定的人工审批门控，在不依赖私有对话交接的情况下，实现生产级编码代理在共享可审计仓库状态上的协调运行。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Loop Engineering, a method that coordinates multiple asynchronous coding-agent loops over shared, auditable repository state by specifying each loop with six elements (trigger, context projection, authority boundary, verifier, stop condition, write-back rule), combined with versioned Skills contracts, an evidence-collecting Harness, and version-bound human approval gates.
